name: Gaussian Splat Rendering (Screen-Space Quad)
definition: Renders 3D Gaussian splats as screen-space quads using a pre-sorted order buffer and view-space projection data, handling transparency via alpha blending and discarding fragments behind the camera or with negligible alpha.
summary: Gaussian Splat Rendering (Screen-Space Quad) projects 3D Gaussians into 2D quads in the vertex shader for precise frustum culling and selection, unlike CPU-sorted instanced methods.
